newsitem.title: USA: CME August 1996 volume falls 2.1 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: CME August 1996 volume falls 2.1 pct year-on-year.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) said its August volume totalled 14,608,776 contracts, down 2.1 percent from 14,928,351 a year earlier.
Average daily volume in August, however, rose 2.3 percent to 664,035 contracts from 649,059, the exchange added.
Cumulative volume for the first eight months of 1996 totalled 134,795,324 contracts, down 6.1 percent from 143,619,687 during the same 1995 period.
Total futures volume in August fell 5.1 percent from a year earlier to 11,253,993 contracts, while total options volume increased 9.2 percent to 3,354,783.
